name: Venture Company
summary: Across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, Venture Company crews strip-mine and clear-cut land, heedless of its people and nature. Mogul Razdunk directs the ruthless goblin cartel from afar. Its crews seek raw materials with heavy machinery, away from major goblin ports like Booty Bay and Ratchet.

sections.title: Industrial Plunder
sections.body: Venture Company crews tear into the land for raw materials. Mogul Razdunk directs the cartel from afar, and workers wield heavy machinery across Azeroth. Shredders harvest timber, drilling rigs bore into the earth, and refineries process what they find. The cartel takes resources by force, ignoring treaties, borders, and local rights.

sections.title: Encroaching on Kalimdor
sections.body:
Across Kalimdor, Venture Company crews have made enemies. In Mulgore, Supervisor Fizsprocket sent drills and mining rigs into the eastern bluffs, though the tauren had denied the cartel mineral rights. The work polluted water wells across the plains. Farther north, the cartel turned the Barrens' Sludge Fen into a chemical sewer for its oil pumps. It also claimed the Horde's former Boulder Lode Mine, where it conducted dangerous experiments with samophlanges and toxic brews.

At Windshear Crag in Stonetalon, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle directs the logging crews. The mad leper gnome's colossal Super Reaper 6000 machines have felled whole groves.

sections.title: Corporate Rivalries and Shady Contracts
sections.body:
Venture Company has angered fellow goblins and made other enemies. Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay often hires crews to strike the cartel's base camp and oil rig at Lake Nazferiti. He means to halt their encroachment and take their advanced shredder fuel regulators. Ratchet's Tinkers' Union spies on the cartel to steal engineering plans.

SI:7 and the Shattered Hand have uncovered the cartel's trade in dangerous alchemical compounds. It sells Zanzil's mind-altering poisons to Defias necromancers in Westfall. Toxic fumes also help it breed mutated drone laborers.

faq.answer: Mogul Razdunk leads Venture Company from afar and directs its larger ventures. Regional supervisors, foremen, and hired overseers run work sites across Azeroth. They include Supervisor Fizsprocket in Mulgore, Supervisor Lugwizzle at the Sludge Fen, and Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle in Stonetalon.

faq.q: Why does the Horde hate the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The Horde hates Venture Company for exploiting lands it considers ancestral. In Mulgore, the cartel entered the eastern mountains without permission and fouled the tauren's sacred water wells. In the Barrens, it seized the Horde's Boulder Lode Mine and fouled the Sludge Fen with a noxious oil slick.

faq.q: Are they affiliated with the Steamwheedle Cartel or Booty Bay?
faq.answer: No. Venture Company is separate from the Steamwheedle Cartel, and the two are fierce corporate enemies. Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay often hires mercenaries to disrupt its logging in Stranglethorn Vale. Sputtervalve of Ratchet sends operatives to sabotage its shredders and steal its blueprints.

faq.q: Why is a leper gnome running operations in Windshear Crag?
faq.answer: Venture Company hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle for his ruthless mechanical skill and his design of the massive Super Reaper 6000. His hiring angered goblin engineers such as Ziz Fizziks and the Trade Princes in Undermine. They disapproved of Razdunk dealing with the outcast gnome.

faq.q: What is the Venture Company doing in Westfall?
faq.answer: Venture Company traded illicitly with the Defias Brotherhood. The cartel acquired Zanzilli poisons and sold the mixture to Defias operative Klaven Mortwake in Westfall. He used it to make mindless Defias Drones like the laborers found at Venture Company sites.

faq.q: What is being produced at the Sludge Fen?
faq.answer: Venture Company built an industrial drilling rig over a spring that was once clear. It pumps and refines oil while dumping toxic sludge across the northern Barrens. Researchers there also test complex mechanical samophlanges and synthesize toxic mixtures.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know Venture Company invaded Mulgore's sacred hills without permission. Its crews poisoned ancestral wells and cut timber against the Earth Mother's will.
As a druid, you see the harm in Venture Company's heavy logging in Stonetalon and its pollution of natural springs in Mulgore and the Barrens.
As a rogue, you know the Shattered Hand and SI:7 watch Venture Company's poison trade closely. Their agents infiltrate its towers and sabotage high-ranking foremen to seize deadly chemical mixtures.
As an engineer, you know Venture Company builds some of Azeroth's finest shredders and mechanical regulators. Other companies prize its blueprints and seek to steal them.
